fact_description: DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy on the Physics benchmark

true_probe.statement: DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy on the Physics benchmark. Is this correct?
true_probe.raw_response:
Looking at the Physics benchmark in the figure, I need to compare the heights of all bars:

- DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue): ~57.5%
- DAPO (hatched blue): ~58.2%
- SRPO (solid orange): ~60.5%
- GRPO (hatched orange): ~56.8%
- PPO+Self-reflection (solid green): ~61%
- PPO (hatched green): ~59.1%

PPO+Self-reflection appears to have the highest accuracy on Physics, not DAPO+Self-reflection.

{"answer": "B", "explanation": "PPO+Self-reflection has highest accuracy on Physics benchmark."}
